About Us

Top Air HVAC is a locally owned and operated heating and cooling company based right here in Smithfield, NC. We started this business because we believe homeowners and businesses in Johnston County deserve honest, reliable HVAC service without the upsell games or the runaround.

We live and work in this community. When we show up at your door, you're getting a neighbor who cares about the job — not a call center dispatch sending out whoever is closest. Every estimate is free, every quote is straight, and every job gets done right.
